description.summary: An invisible tree-dwelling creature that hurls branches, dead wood, and debris at passersby from hollow trees, never seen but known by its aggressive wood-throwing.
description.full: The Agropelter is a fearsome critter that inhabits hollow trees in lumber regions. This creature has never been seen directly—it remains invisible or moves too quickly to observe. Its presence is known only through its signature behavior: violently hurling branches, chunks of wood, and tree debris at lumberjacks and travelers passing below. According to the tall tales, the Agropelter lives in hollow tree trunks and emerges only to throw wood at victims. The creature provided a humorous explanation for falling branches and widow-makers (dead branches that fall unexpectedly), turning a genuine forest hazard into a mischievous invisible assailant.
